messages:
maya: Quick design review — the scanline nav in the regression diff list feels jumpy when tabbing through rows. proto: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/scanline-proto :eyes.

james_h: saw that. agree the motion is a bit much. think a 120ms ease-out and a persistent focus ring would help.

ava: accessibility thought — keyboard focus should not only move the visual scanline but also announce row content via an aria-live region so screen reader users know the change.

linh: +1 on aria-live. also the current blue scanline contrast fails AA on some monitors. can we test #0056d6 vs #003e9e?

maya: good call. design note: reduce scanline thickness from 4px to 2px and make it a subtle shadow instead of full bar. preserves context without stealing attention.

samir: practical constraint — the diff list is virtualized; when we programmatically move focus we see a 60–120ms render gap where the row re-mounts. might be what folks perceive as jitter.

james_h: can we debounce the visible scanline animation until virtualization finish? maybe a short 40ms delay.

ava: demo suggestion: on focus, fire aria-live with a short summary like: "Change: added 2 lines, prompt set: checkout_flow" so that SR users get meaningful context. keep those messages concise.

linh: copy nit — the approve button in the inline scorecard says "Approve run" but in other places we use "Confirm approval". can we standardize to "Approve" to reduce cognitive load?

maya: yep, let's standardize to "Approve". also propose sticky approval CTA in the right rail when a row is selected (so people don't have to scroll).

samir: implementation note: sticky rail needs to account for mobile width < 480px — collapse to a bottom sheet.

design-bot: uploaded a quick screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/scanline-v2.png

james_h: CSS snippet for focus ring I tried locally: ```css
.row:focus { outline: 3px solid #ffb84d; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); }
```

ava: that outline color is high contrast and works well. can we avoid using only color (add dashed border for edge cases)?

maya: action items: 1) dev infra: try 40ms debounce + 120ms animation (samir/james), 2) design: test #003e9e vs #0056d6 and 2px shadow (maya/linh), 3) copy: change button to "Approve" (linh), 4) a11y: add aria-live summary (ava). I'll ping you all in a week for an updated prototype. :thumbsup:
